scope: Record the nine local native-geometry views actually inspected in this session.
findings: R1702 rotates 180 to 0 degrees in place; R1703 translates +0.55,-0.42 mm to (49.05,9.98). Values and pin nets are unchanged.
The two-resistor middle-node route becomes 1.728528 mm instead of 2.107107 mm. R1703 output is a single straight 2.47 mm vertical segment joining the unchanged long INA+ trunk.

The new 0.20 mm WHEEL_VM sense branch is 8.147372 mm, follows deliberate diagonal/vertical bends around fixed ground and supply holes, and joins the original R1101.2 land without a new via. It does not carry actuator load current.

Ten source segments are removed and eleven are added. Six removed 0.35 mm front 3V3 inter-via segments are geometrically redundant with the unchanged In3 3V3 fill; all fifty old width tests and additional local via/capacitor comparisons are preserved.
The original In2/In3 3V3 fills and In1/In4 GND fills have zero geometric symmetric difference. Every supply/ground via stays fixed, and the back escape geometry remains unchanged.
R1702 and R1703 native courtyards now have 0.03 mm gap; R1703.2 to the fixed nearby GND via has 0.296262 mm copper gap. These library/native distances are not assembly tolerance qualification.

All eleven new tracks were checked against nominal Fab bodies outside same-net lands; there are zero new mounted-face hits. Opposite-face projections are limited to C505 and U1701 and reviewed separately.
The symmetric R1702 native body guard is geometrically invariant under the exact 180 degree rotation. R1703 guard moves exactly with its part; no guard is removed or weakened.
